verses.1: You are beautiful, my beloved. Your eyes are beautiful; they shine with joy from within you. Your lips are like the melody of birds that fly from the mountain Gilad.
verses.2: Change it like the compass that indicates the direction of the winds. All of them are aligned with each other, and there’s no discrepancy in their alignment.
verses.3: May your second lips be like the lips of a dove, and may your mouth be pure as a mountain. May your speech be gentle and kind, instead of harsh and rude.
verses.4: As David grew in stature, his crown became magnificent. All the rulers of the nobles were placed upon it.
verses.5: Two days later, when two clouds appear, they are the signs of the coming of Tzvia.
verses.6: Until today comes and the winds try their strength, I will go to Mount Mor and to the land of Labona.
verses.7: You are beautiful, my beloved; but in you there is nothing.
verses.8: From Bethlehem, I come; from Bethlehem I shall enter. May my steps be guided by the light of faith. From the heights of mountains and from the depths of valleys, may my path be clear.
verses.9: My sister has given me a gift from one of your eyes, from one of the giants in your palace.
verses.10: What beautiful are your breasts, my beloved! What wonderful are your breasts! Your scent is more pleasant than that of all other women.
verses.11: Your lips will be covered with dust; milk will cover your mouth. The scent of your perfumes will be like the scent of lilies.
verses.12: My sister’s garden was destroyed; all its flowers were lost.
verses.13: Send your angels with gifts of fruits, as bees with honey.
verses.14: Let them go up and bring back goods and merchandise, along with all the tools needed for construction. And let them also bring back tents and shelters, along with all the leaders of the heavens.
verses.15: Let the gardens be filled with living water creatures and fish from the sea.
verses.16: May the trees of Zaphon be green again, and may their branches bloom with flowers. May my Lord come to his garden and eat the fruits from it.
